title: Atmospheric aging suppresses the formation of limonene-derived organic peroxides
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2026, 28,419-430
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM00823A, Paper
Xiaowen Chen, Yunyan Zhao, Shan Zhang, Lin Du, Kun Li
Atmospheric aging suppresses limonene-derived organic peroxides. HOMs become decoupled from peroxide functionality, with peroxides accounting for 100% of HOMs at low aging but only 27% at high aging.
